curiosities: Its two Joy-Con slide off to give two players a controller each.
It runs on an Nvidia Tegra X1 chip.
Its game cards are coated to taste bitter, so children spit them out.
With over 150 million sold, it is Nintendo's best-selling home console.
The Switch Lite of 2019 is handheld only, with the controllers built in.
The OLED model of 2021 has a 7-inch OLED screen.
The right Joy-Con has an infrared camera, and both have HD Rumble.
Docked it shows up to 1080p; its own screen is 720p.
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild launched with it, and on the Wii U the same day.
Its successor, the Switch 2 of June 2025, plays most of its games.
